name: SendExchangeEmailMessage
label: Send Exchange Email Message
description: Creates and sends a new email message using an Exchange connection.

fields.name: ExchangeConnection
fields.label: Exchange Connection
fields.description: The Exchange service object representing the connection to the Exchange server.

fields.name: From
fields.label: From
fields.description: The sender's email address or display name.

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The subject of the email message.

fields.name: Body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: The body content of the email message.

fields.name: IsBodyHtml
fields.label: Body is HTML
fields.description: If true, treats the body as HTML content.

fields.name: Attachments
fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: Paths to files to attach to the email message (comma-separated).
